description: Two-page bilingual Chinese/English monthly payslip (工资单) of a fictional company, produced with fpdf2 2.9.0 with an embedded subset of WenQuanYi Zen Hei (font 0 of wqy-zenhei.ttc, TrueType, Identity-H) for all text. Page 1: employee grid with bordered cells, earnings and deductions tables (deductions in parentheses, e.g. (1,440.00)), net pay in a framed box and in Chinese capital numerals (金额大写); page 2: daily attendance table, unchanged. Edits: department, pay date, the last four digits of the bank account, and the special additional deduction (2,000.00 -> 3,000.00), which lowers the income tax; total deductions, net pay and the amount in words are recomputed. Social-insurance amounts and gross pay do not change. No re-flow.

truth.note: 部门 Department; Chinese and English in one cell.
Masked bank account number: payout account changed, which a reviewer must not miss.
专项附加扣除 in the employee grid; the same value 2,000.00 also appears as the position allowance, hence the label in the snippet.
个人所得税 Individual income tax, a deduction in parentheses.

truth.old: 人民币壹万柒仟陆佰叁拾柒元肆角整
truth.new: 人民币壹万柒仟柒佰叁拾柒元肆角整
truth.note: Net pay in Chinese capital numerals; only one character differs (陆 -> 柒, six -> seven hundred). Typed as replace because it is written in words; a report as a number change is equally correct.
